subject: BlueNova demo — can we pause while you reallocate sprint work?
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Harris <susan.harris@bluenova.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@bluenova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo — BlueNova + Redwood Inference (proposed times)

Hi Susan / Tom —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation, I pulled together a short, focused demo of our inference runtime and cost/latency tradeoffs for the kind of batch+real-time mix you described. I propose a 30–40 minute session (demo + quick Q&A) to walk through:

- Concrete latency/cost examples for your 1k–10k TPS slices
- How prefix/KV caching could reduce repeated query cost
- Deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC) for BlueNova's compliance needs

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Oct 7 — 10:00–10:40
- Thu Oct 8 — 13:00–13:40
- Fri Oct 9 — 09:30–10:10

I've attached a draft mutual-action-plan that outlines a 4–6 week pilot path (goals, success metrics, owners). If those slots don't work, tell me a few windows that do and we'll adapt.

Attached: mutual-action-plan.xlsx
Invite: calendar-invite.ics

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Susan Harris <susan.harris@bluenova.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@bluenova.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — BlueNova + Redwood Inference (proposed times)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the follow-up and the MAP.

Quick update from our side: leadership just re-prioritized Q4 to focus on an analytics platform rewrite. That pulled the majority of our infra and product bandwidth for the next 6–8 weeks. Given that, we need to deprioritize the inference pilot for now and hold off on demos until we have a clearer timeline.

Can we park the demo and plan to reconnect in early Q1? I don't want to lose the thread — this is still of interest — but we need to shift effort to the analytics rewrite right away.

Also, with the budget freeze in place for Q4, we won't be initiating new pilots until the reset. If you want to keep us on a light nurture cadence, a one-pager that summarizes integration effort + typical security artifacts would be useful to share with our infra leads while we're heads-down.

Apologies for the churn — happy to re-open when timelines stabilize.

Best,
Susan Harris
Director, Product — BlueNova Systems
susan.harris@bluenova.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Harris <susan.harris@bluenova.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@bluenova.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — BlueNova + Redwood Inference (proposed times)

On Tue, Oct 6, 2026 at 11:02 AM Susan Harris <susan.harris@bluenova.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marcus — appreciate the follow-up and the MAP.

Given that, we need to deprioritize the inference pilot for now and hold off on demos until we have a clearer timeline.
> 
> Can we park the demo and plan to reconnect in early Q1? I don't want to lose the thread — this is still of interest — but we need to shift effort to the analytics rewrite right away.

Totally understand — thanks for the candid update, Susan.

Two quick items from my side:
1) I'll mark this as "deferred — prospect reprioritized" in our CRM and set a follow-up for Jan 2027. I'll drop the MAP into the HubSpot record so your team can re-open later without hunting.
2) Monica (cc) will send a 1‑page security/integration summary that you can share with infra — it highlights typical network requirements, KMS patterns, and audit logging we surface for Private deployments.

If it helps, we're also happy to do a 20-minute, purely asynchronous tech-screen (no demo) that answers specific infra questions while your team is in the freeze — low lift on both sides. No pressure — just an option.

I'll hold off on scheduling and will follow up in Jan. Would you prefer a mid-Jan check-in (week of Jan 10) or later in the month?

Thanks again, and we appreciate being kept in the loop.

—Marcus
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Harris <susan.harris@bluenova.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security summary + next steps (short note)

Hi Susan / Tom —

Following Marcus' note: attached is a concise security/integration brief that covers the common questions we see when prospects pause on pilots but still need artifacts for internal review. It includes:

- Deployment models and where customer data resides
- KMS/HSM integration patterns and typical keys of contact
- Audit log samples and retention options

Attached: security-brief.pdf

I'll also add a short checklist you can drop into an internal RFC. If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute call in December for a targeted infra Q&A — otherwise we'll reconvene in Jan per Marcus.

Thanks and good luck with the rewrite — let us know if anything changes.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
